Strata Cleaning Melbourne

Strata Cleaning Melbourne is common-area cleaning for strata buildings – foyers, lifts, carparks and amenities, run as a contracted service to a documented standard.

get a strata cleaning quote

What does a strata clean include?

A strata clean covers foyers, lifts, carparks and shared amenities on every scheduled visit – each area scoped and quality-checked.

The visit scope for strata cleaning services covers:

Foyers.

Entry glass polished, floors mopped, letterboxes and intercoms wiped.

Lifts.

Walls, buttons and floors detailed; high-touch points sanitised every visit.

Carparks.

Sweeping, litter pickup and stain spotting on a set rotation.

Shared amenities.

Gym equipment, pool surrounds and common rooms reset, with consumables restocked under the restocking clause.

Bin rooms, storage cages and plant corridors join the rotation on monthly cycles. The scope also names what stays out: individual lots, balcony glass and appliances inside apartments remain the owner's job.

Weekly cycles add deeper detail like skirting, cobwebs and bin-room wash-downs to the same written scope.

Which services pair with strata cleaning?

Commercial office cleaning pairs with strata cleaning for managers running mixed-use buildings – related services, one invoice.

Commercial office cleaning – workplace scope for the office floors inside the same mixed-use building.

Body corporate cleaning – the owners-corporation contract variant, where the committee signs the scope and the manager files the reporting.

Strata window cleaning – common glazing, foyer glass and facade panels on a specialist rotation.

Strata floor scrubbing – machine scrubbing for foyer tiles, corridors and car park decks on a cyclical program.

Bundling keeps one supervisor, one audit cycle and one invoice across common areas and tenanted floors, and each child program inherits the same written standard.

How often should common areas be cleaned?

Common-area frequency follows traffic – foyers and lifts need daily attention, carparks and shared amenities a weekly cycle.

The common-area schedule matches resident load. High-traffic foyers and lift cars take daily attention through the working week; carparks, storage corridors and shared amenities hold a weekly cycle with monthly detail passes on top.

The strata cleaning checklist sets out the common-area items and their frequencies for committees auditing a scope.

Quiet buildings stretch the roster; busy towers tighten it – the site audit sets the starting point and the visit log adjusts it.

Short-stay towers and school-holiday buildings shift the load again, so the roster tightens around occupancy peaks instead of holding a flat weekly shape residents never see.

What questions do strata managers ask?

These questions cover cost, supplies and responsibility before a Melbourne strata manager books a site audit:

What is strata cleaning?

shared-area contract work: foyers, lifts, carparks and amenities held to a written standard.

What is a good daily cleaning schedule for an apartment?

for shared areas: foyers and lifts daily, amenities weekly.

Do cleaners bring their own supplies?

yes; chemicals, cloths and machines come priced in.

What is the hourly rate or per-hour cost for a cleaner in Melbourne?

folded into a flat monthly invoice.

What is the 20 minute rule in cleaning?

a short daily reset beats a deep rescue; the roster applies the idea.

How often should a 1-bedroom apartment be cleaned?

inside lots sits with the owner; the contract covers common areas.

How to write a cleaning contract agreement?

verify, don't draft: scope, service levels, reporting, exit terms.

What are the three types of cleaning?

daily upkeep, periodic deep work and specialist services on one roster.

Are body corporate responsible for windows, and repairs in Victoria?

common-property glazing and repairs, yes; lot interiors sit with each owner.

What is a good cleaning fee?

a written scope compared across bidders.

What are the best strata cleaning services in Melbourne?

named crew, supervisor QA and reporting per invoice.
